subject: Request to shift BrightFin demo — overlapping calendar conflict

From: Samantha Lowe <samantha@brightfin.co>
To: ava_chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, May 26, 2026 at 2:22 PM PDT
Subject: Quick intro + demo request (BrightFin)

Hi Ava / Jordan,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday — we'd like to get a product demo scheduled for the BrightFin core payments team. Our CFO (Oliver Hayes) and our Head of Product want to attend to evaluate latency and cost assumptions.

Can we do Wednesday, May 28 at 10:00 AM PT? That time works best for our leadership. Attendees from our side: Samantha (IT), Oliver (CFO), Priya (Product).

I've attached a short note on our priorities so you can tailor the walkthrough. If that slot doesn't work, we can share some alternative windows later this week. Looking forward to it.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Lowe
Director of IT, BrightFin
attachments: brightfin_requirements.pdf (pdf, 92KB)
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, May 26, 2026 at 3:05 PM PDT
Subject: Re: Quick intro + demo request (BrightFin)

Hi Samantha — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for sending the priorities doc. We can absolutely tailor the demo to cover latency SLAs, cost controls, and deployment options.

Quick heads up: our senior SE, Dev Patel, is currently committed to an on-site POC on the morning of May 28 and is double-booked at 10:00 AM PT. Dev brings the kernel/quantization detail you asked for, so we want him on the call if possible.

Options:
- Move to Wed, May 28 at 1:30 PM PT (same day but later) — Dev can join live then.
- Thu, May 29 between 10:00–12:00 PT — open.
- If you prefer to keep 10:00 AM on Wed, Jordan can lead the high-level demo and we can schedule a follow-up deep-dive with Dev within 48 hours.

I've attached a one-pager for background. If you want to lock the 1:30 PM slot I can send an updated calendar invite.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
redwood.ai
